evals.prompt: Send a push notification to my Gotify server saying 'Backup completed successfully' with title 'Backup' and priority 5.
evals.expected_output: Uses gotify MCP tool with action=send, message='Backup completed successfully', title='Backup', priority=5

evals.prompt: Check the health of my Gotify server and show me the last 10 messages.
evals.expected_output: Calls gotify(action='health') then gotify(action='messages', limit=10), presents both results clearly

evals.prompt: I need to clean up my Gotify server. First show me all my applications, then delete all messages. Be careful about the delete.
evals.expected_output: Calls gotify(action='applications') to list them, then warns about destructive operation, asks for confirmation before calling gotify(action='delete_all_messages', confirm=True)

evals.prompt: Create a new Gotify application called 'HomeAutomation' with description 'Smart home events' and default priority 3, then send a test notification through it.
evals.expected_output: Calls create_application, then send — notes that send uses the app token not client token, explains the token model if relevant
